description: Source code for TaskSetExcludelist class in Apache Spark, managing executor and node exclusions within a task set, including failure tracking and exclusion logic.

classes.name: TaskSetExcludelist
classes.description: Manages exclusion of executors and nodes during a Spark task set, tracking failures and applying exclusion policies.

methods.name: getLatestFailureReason
methods.description: Returns the most recent failure reason for this task set.

methods.name: isExecutorExcludedForTask
methods.description: Checks if an executor is excluded for a specific task index.

methods.name: isNodeExcludedForTask
methods.description: Checks if a node is excluded for a specific task index.

methods.name: isExecutorExcludedForTaskSet
methods.description: Checks if an executor is excluded for the entire task set.

methods.name: isNodeExcludedForTaskSet
methods.description: Checks if a node is excluded for the entire task set.

methods.name: updateExcludedForFailedTask
methods.description: Updates exclusion status based on a failed task, potentially excluding the executor or node.
